📋 Import without a file picker (paste the backup text)

Use this if the file picker won't let you choose your backup. On the other device tap Copy backup to clipboard, send that text to yourself (Notes, Mail, a message), paste it below and tap Load pasted JSON. Nothing is applied until you review the list and confirm.

💳 Premium Payment Breakdown
🧮 Benefit In Force, by Age (50–100)

Assumes each policy's cover stays in force until its "Coverage Till Age" (edit a policy to set this — blank/0 is treated as ongoing/whole-life). Shows every age from 50 to 100 — unless a current age under 50 is set for this portfolio above, in which case it steps in 10-year intervals from that age up to 100. Verify against your actual contracts before relying on this for planning.

💰 Premium Payments, by Age (50–99)

Projects each policy's current premium forward at today's rate until its "Premium Payments Stop At Age" (edit a policy to set this — blank/0 is treated as ongoing/unknown). Shows every age from 50 to 99 — unless a current age under 50 is set for this portfolio above, in which case it steps in 10-year intervals from that age up to 99 (the three children default to this). A policy that finishes paying before the first age shown won't appear here at all, even though it's part of your current total premium shown elsewhere. This does not account for future premium increases, reviews, or inflation — verify before relying on this for planning.

📥 Import policies (Excel / Text / PDF)

Pick a file with the buttons below. On iPhone, if your file isn't listed, tap Browse → On My iPhone or iCloud Drive. The line under the tabs names the exact file that was read and the result, so any failure is visible on screen.

Excel
Paste text
PDF

Upload an .xlsx/.csv with a header row. Columns are matched by name (insurer, policy number, policy name, effective date, age at issue, ownership, beneficiary, premium monthly, premium yearly, mode, death, tpd, ci, early ci, disability income, hospital surgical, cash value, premium till, coverage till age, remarks) — the header row can be anywhere in the top 20 rows, every sheet is scanned, and the Excel organizer file works as-is. Policies without a "Coverage till age" are treated as whole-life in the death-by-age table.

Paste CSV or tab-separated rows, first row = headers (same field names as above).

PDF layouts vary too much to auto-map reliably, so this extracts the raw text — review it, then copy the relevant lines into the "Paste text" tab (as CSV/tab rows) or add policies manually below.
